statement: AMD announced a strategic partnership with Anthropic covering up to 2 gigawatts of MI450 Series GPUs
why: A frontier model developer committing gigawatt-scale capacity to AMD silicon is a real crack in single-vendor accelerator supply.

impact.mechanism: A named frontier-lab design win at gigawatt scale converts AMD from challenger to a second qualified source, and pulls forward power and data-centre buildout to host it.

confidence.basis: Announced by AMD in its own earnings release; capacity stated as an upper bound.

dispersion: Stated as up to 2 gigawatts, an upper bound rather than a firm commitment.
